summary.en: If you mute the producer’s choices, the "band sound" disappears.
summary.zh: 把制作人的选择 Mute 掉，「乐队声音」往往一起消失。

body.en:
George Martin with the Beatles. Butch Vig on Nevermind. Flood / Alan Moulder on half the 90s alternative map. Fans argue guitars; engineers argue compression, mic placement, and which take survives.

When a band switches producers and "loses the magic," check the credits before you blame the new bassist.
body.zh:
George Martin 之于披头士。Butch Vig 之于 Nevermind。Flood / Alan Moulder 之于半张 90 年代 alternative 地图。粉丝吵吉他；工程师吵压缩、话筒位、哪条 take 留下。

乐队换制作人然后「没魔力了」——先查 credits，再骂新贝斯手。

note.en: Martin as arranging / studio co-author in the public myth.
note.zh: Martin 在公共神话里是编曲 / 录音室共同作者。

note.en: Nevermind polish vs In Utero raw—producer choice as identity fight.
note.zh: Nevermind 抛光 vs In Utero 毛边——制作人选择当身份战。
